story.title: My Story
story.paragraph1: I'm Muneer Radwan, an Information Technology engineer who moved into Flutter development because it let me design polished cross-platform experiences with a single toolkit. Over the past two years I've built commercial apps that span e-commerce, legal-tech, service marketplaces, and productivity tooling.
story.paragraph2: My CV journey highlights the things I care about: rigor in networking and systems, real-world shipping experience inside agencies and tech teams, and the ability to move from UI polish all the way down to notification plumbing, analytics, and release automation.
story.paragraph3: I'm motivated by products that demand both performance and empathy for end users—apps that feel beautiful while handling serious business workflows.

medtour.title: MedTour.sy
medtour.tagline: Medical tourism OS for patients, partners, and coordinators
medtour.description: MedTour.sy delivers a premium landing experience that guides medical travelers through the brand story, curated services, logistics support, and call-to-action moments. The public hero screens highlight hero narratives, modular sections for services, how-it-works flows, testimonials, multilingual content, and CTA cards that route visitors to coordinators, reflecting a cohesive marketing-to-product journey.

challenge.title: Challenge
challenge.body: International patients needed a single, trusted destination to browse treatments, compare centers and hotels, and hand off logistics to coordinators without friction.

solution.title: Solution
solution.body: Designed and shipped a Flutter-powered platform with guided onboarding, partner verification, and a role-aware workspace that keeps admins, centers, hotels, doctors, and travelers in sync.

2.title: Role-aware dashboards
2.description: Post-login routing launches bespoke home screens for Admin, Center Owner, Hotel Owner, Doctor, and Customer roles with curated menus.

ovacs.title: OVACS Mobile Suite
ovacs.tagline: One command center for coordinators, case managers, and clinicians
ovacs.industry: Case, Client, Session And Document Management System
ovacs.description: OVACS is a cross-platform Flutter workspace built for regulated care teams. It unifies onboarding, dashboards, clients, cases, sessions, documents, messaging, and compliance workflows so coordinators, case managers, and clinicians can run the entire practice without bouncing between tools.

challenge.title: Challenge
challenge.body: Care teams juggled disconnected tools for clients, cases, messaging, and compliance, creating context switching, audit gaps, and onboarding drag for new staff.

solution.title: Solution
solution.body: Designed OVACS as a guided Flutter suite with shared navigation, reusable CRUD patterns, and opinionated QA checklists so every module behaves consistently while staying HIPAA-ready.

0.title: First-time entry playbook
0.description: Splash → onboarding carousel → multi-option sign-in with SSO, guest tenants, and granular validation keeps the first-run experience on-brand and secure.

1.title: Dashboard telling the whole story
1.description: KPIs, smart feed, quick search, and contextual FAB shortcuts launch users into the right module with filters already applied.

2.title: Universal CRUD rails
2.description: Every module mirrors the list → filter → detail → action rhythm, so QA, product, and engineering speak the same language across Connections, Clients, Cases, Sessions, and more.

steps.0: JWT + refresh tokens persist via secure storage with biometric unlock.
